submission.justification: Crystal-K3 at 5 cm gave the best 662 keV energy resolution of the three permitted candidates. Recorded FWHM is 2.904%, the 2025 nominal value is 2.9%, and a rerun gave 3.008%. The rerun is about 0.1 percentage point higher, but K3 remains well ahead of K1 (4.42%) and K2 (8.66%) at 5 cm. Across the thicknesses tested for K3, 5 cm was the best: 2 cm gave 3.24% and 10 cm gave 4.48%. Only 2, 5 and 10 cm were simulated, so 5 cm is the best tested point, not a verified global optimum over 2 to 10 cm. The screening recorded zero low-background disqualifications for any candidate. The underlying low-background criteria are not reproduced in the results, so that suitability rests on the recorded screen result. The thickness is within the 2 to 10 cm limit and the crystal is a listed candidate.
